## Orientation

Work in /home/ayin/se-workflow. Edit scripts/session_report.py and tests/test_session_report.py only. Use read_records from scripts/record_reader.py and join from scripts/record_join.py; do not edit them. read_records takes a project root path and queries one store, so group sessions by cwd, query each distinct cwd whose store exists under ~/.artifacts/<basename> once, and skip cwds with no store. Tests inject a fake runner and must not touch the real store. The real adaptive-artifacts on PATH needs --store, which read_records already passes. Do not edit .artifacts/.
